versions.changelog: Rewrote frontmatter description to concise 200–500 character format for improved agent-trigger clarity.

Initial release. Four-phase HSEEP-aligned AAR/IP workflow covering scoping (exercise / incident metadata, objectives, Core Capabilities, scenario), evidence intake (evaluator EEG notes, hotwash, participant feedback, controller logs), Core-Capability rating and analysis (Performed without Challenges / with Some Challenges / with Major Challenges / Unable to be Performed), and Improvement Plan drafting (SMART corrective actions, capability-element mapping, primary responsible organization, POC, start / completion dates). DRAFT-only, for exercise-director or IC review and sign-off.
